description: This file contains unit tests for the BasketService class, specifically testing the transfer of baskets between anonymous and user accounts in an e-commerce application. It uses the xUnit framework and NSubstitute for mocking dependencies.

classes.name: TransferBasket
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for the BasketService's TransferBasketAsync method, including scenarios with existing baskets, non-existent baskets, and basket item transfers.

methods.name: InvokesBasketRepositoryFirstOrDefaultAsyncOnceIfAnonymousBasketNotExists
methods.description: Tests that the repository's FirstOrDefaultAsync method is called once when the anonymous basket does not exist.

methods.name: TransferAnonymousBasketItemsWhilePreservingExistingUserBasketItems
methods.description: Verifies that anonymous basket items are transferred correctly to an existing user basket, preserving existing items.

methods.name: RemovesAnonymousBasketAfterUpdatingUserBasket
methods.description: Confirms that the anonymous basket is deleted after its items have been transferred to the user basket.

methods.name: CreatesNewUserBasketIfNotExists
methods.description: Checks that a new basket is created when transferring to a user account that does not have an existing basket.
